name: Reconstruct Surfaces from LB Eigenfunctions
summary: Reconstructs each VTK surface mesh from its first Laplace-Beltrami eigenfunctions with compiled MATLAB code and outputs the reconstructed surfaces and comparison images.
description: For each .vtk surface in the input (or a single named surface when single_surf is true), computes spectrum_size Laplace-Beltrami eigenfunctions and reconstructs the mesh from them, saving the reconstructed surfaces and six views each of the original and reconstructed shapes. Use it to see how much shape detail a given number of eigenfunctions captures before Laplace-Beltrami shape analysis. Meshes with too few vertices are skipped.

inputs.description: Directory of triangle surface meshes in VTK format.

outputs.description: PNG images (listed in images.json) showing six views of each original and reconstructed surface.
Surfaces reconstructed from the selected number of Laplace-Beltrami eigenfunctions.

parameters.description: Include the full filename of the surface you want to reconstruct. Best practice is to copy it directly from the 3D surfaces app output
parameters.placeholder: full filename of the single surface you want to reconstruct

parameters.description: Number of Laplace-Beltrami eigenfunctions used to reconstruct each surface.
parameters.placeholder: number of eigenfunctions you want to use in the reconstruction

citations.text: Kitchell L. Shape Analysis of Human White Matter Tracts: An Examination of Normal Morphological Variability and the Association Between Morphology, Brain Size, and Behavior. Indiana University (2020).
Avesani P, et al. The open diffusion data derivatives, brain data upcycling via integrated publishing of derivatives and reproducible open cloud services. Sci Data 6:69 (2019).

failure_modes.fix: Check that the input contains readable .vtk meshes and that singlesurf_filename matches a file when single_surf is true.
